search_window.basis: From completed_at in the latest verified prior Food Line Source Watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; inclusion requires a new corroborated announcement or disruption since that check, not merely a fresh crawl/index date.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only. Nationwide production collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster of the only, sole, last, or full-service community grocery
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended by storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank closure or major food access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: November 1 2026 SNAP EBT benefits delayed suspended today official state announcement
November 1 2026 WIC benefits payment outage service interruption state health department
Nov 1 2026 "only grocery store" fire closed town
November 1 2026 food bank emergency distribution canceled storm power outage
November 1 2026 food pantry abruptly closed fire flooding damage
Nov 1 2026 food assistance offices emergency closed storm food distribution hurricane Lowell Hawaii
coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted searches returned usable results, but no fresh, independently verifiable, qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found after the preceding 11:43:39 PST heartbeat. High-ranked results were mainly 2025 SNAP shutdown coverage, September 2026 sole-grocery fire coverage, older Hawaii hurricane recovery resources, or republication of already tracked Utah food-bank closure.

excluded_examples.title: Community Action Services and Food Bank closure, Utah/Wasatch/Summit counties
excluded_examples.reason: November 1 secondary recap explicitly attributes prior KSL reporting and describes the known Provo-area closure first reported October 31, already excluded in earlier watches; not a newly discovered disruption this hour.

excluded_examples.title: Town of Spencer recovering after losing only grocery store in fire
excluded_examples.reason: Genuinely high-value sole grocery loss, but September event predates current hourly window.

excluded_examples.title: Texas SNAP November benefits delayed by shutdown
excluded_examples.reason: Historical 2025 SNAP government-shutdown report, not November 2026 benefit interruption.

excluded_examples.title: Hurricane Lowell Kauaʻi recovery information and emergency distributions

duplicate_screen.method: Read prior ledger record on ops/watch-ledger; compared source event and publication dates and previously excluded Utah closure.

coverage_notes.limitations: Time-window/local indexing is imperfect, and targeted search does not guarantee exhaustive detection of yet-unindexed agency/provider notices. No-findings is not proof of no disruptions nationwide.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, production-collector modifications, schedule changes, or disabling.
